You can make out a closed fridge. You can make out an oven. You wonder idly who left that here. You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a table. The table is massive. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. Aw, here you were, all excited for there to be things on it! Hey, want to see a counter? Look over there, a counter! The counter is vast. On the counter you can make out a raw red potato, an orange bell pepper, a cookbook and a knife. You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a stove. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it.
